personal_info.summary: Adept Freelance Fullstack Developer with a proven track record at La Fuente Del Sol S.a., enhancing team productivity by mastering new technologies and languages. Excelled in debugging, significantly improving product stability, and leveraged expertise in JavaScript/Typescript and project management to exceed development goals. Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines in fast-paced environments, ensuring high-quality software solutions.

responsibilities: Worked on several projects including Booknity and Prisma Noticias.

achievements: Creation of the Booknity API using NestJS and full documentation on Swagger.
Collaborated on the implementation of frontend components using React and NextJS.
Conducted tests with React Testing Library, Jest, Jasmine, and Typescript.
Developed an app with React / NodeJS.
Implemented Supabase as the Project's Database.
Containerized the app and a DB instance using Docker.
Implemented unit and integration tests using Jest, Jasmine, and Typescript.
Adhered to agile development practices and collaborative work methodologies.
